message.content:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: wordsmith
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db-init
  namespace: wordsmith
data:
  words.sql: |
    CREATE TABLE nouns (word TEXT NOT NULL);
    CREATE TABLE verbs (word TEXT NOT NULL);
    CREATE TABLE adjectives (word TEXT NOT NULL);

    INSERT INTO nouns(word) VALUES
      ('cloud'),
      ('elephant'),
      ('gø language'),
      ('laptøp'),
      ('cøntainer'),
      ('micrø-service'),
      ('turtle'),
      ('whale'),
      ('gøpher'),
      ('møby døck'),
      ('server'),
      ('bicycle'),
      ('viking'),
      ('mermaid'),
      ('fjørd'),
      ('legø'),
      ('flødebolle'),
      ('smørrebrød');

    INSERT INTO verbs(word) VALUES
      ('will drink'),
      ('smashes'),
      ('smøkes'),
      ('eats'),
      ('walks tøwards'),
      ('løves'),
      ('helps'),
      ('pushes'),
      ('debugs'),
      ('invites'),
      ('hides'),
      ('will ship');

    INSERT INTO adjectives(word) VALUES
      ('the exquisite'),
      ('a pink'),
      ('the røtten'),
      ('a red'),
      ('the serverless'),
      ('a brøken'),
      ('a shiny'),
      ('the pretty'),
      ('the impressive'),
      ('an awesøme'),
      ('the famøus'),
      ('a gigantic'),
      ('the gløriøus'),
      ('the nørdic'),
      ('the welcøming'),
      ('the deliciøus');
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db-credentials
  namespace: wordsmith
type: Opaque
stringData:
  POSTGRES_USER: wordsmith
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: wordsmith
  POSTGRES_DB: wordsmith
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db-pvc
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  serviceName: wordsmith-db
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: wordsmith-db
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: wordsmith-db
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: postgres:10.0-alpine
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5432
          env:
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db-credentials
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db-credentials
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
            - name: POSTGRES_DB
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db-credentials
                  key: POSTGRES_DB
          volumeMounts:
            - name: db-data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
            - name: db-init
              mountPath: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - pg_isready
                - -U
                - $(POSTGRES_USER)
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - pg_isready
                - -U
                - $(POSTGRES_USER)
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 20
      volumes:
        - name: db-init
          configMap:
            name: wordsmith-db-init
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: db-data
      spec:
        accessModes:
          - ReadWriteOnce
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-db
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  selector:
    app: wordsmith-db
  ports:
    - name: postgres
      port: 5432
      targetPort: 5432
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-api
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: wordsmith-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: wordsmith-api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: dockersamples/wordsmith-api
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          env:
            - name: DATABASE_URL
              value: "postgres://$(POSTGRES_USER):$(POSTGRES_PASSWORD)@wordsmith-db:5432/$(POSTGRES_DB)"
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db-credentials
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db-credentials
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
            - name: POSTGRES_DB
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: wordsmith-db-credentials
                  key: POSTGRES_DB
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: "64Mi"
              cpu: "100m"
            limits:
              memory: "128Mi"
              cpu: "250m"
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 20
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-api
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  selector:
    app: wordsmith-api
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 8080
      targetPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-web
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: wordsmith-web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: wordsmith-web
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: dockersamples/wordsmith-web
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
          env:
            - name: API_HOST
              value: "wordsmith-api:8080"
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: "32Mi"
              cpu: "50m"
            limits:
              memory: "64Mi"
              cpu: "100m"
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 80
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 80
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 20
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: wordsmith-web
  namespace: wordsmith
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  selector:
    app: wordsmith-web
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: 80
```
